summary: The note argues that digital transformation is imperative for small businesses in the post-pandemic market and walks through twelve technology areas, from e-commerce to AI. Each area is illustrated with a small business owner or expert who adopted the tool in late 2023 and reported benefits. It concludes that strategic adoption of technology lets small businesses survive and flourish.
one_line: Twelve digital tools and strategies, each illustrated by a small business example, that help small businesses compete in the modern market.
key_facts: The note is dated September 3, 2023 and describes a post-pandemic landscape where digital transformation is imperative for small business survival.
A study published December 1, 2023 indicated that online sales continue to climb; businesses are adopting Shopify and WooCommerce.
Mike Johnson, a local bakery owner, says his online orders have tripled since he went digital in late September 2023.
Cassandra Lee adopted cloud computing in October 2023 to manage her boutique's inventory and customer data across multiple devices; cloud options named are Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure.
Over 4 billion people are active on social media worldwide; Kevin Sanders highlights the rise of Instagram and TikTok ads since summer 2023.
Rachel Gomez, who runs an online gardening store, invested in SEO in early September 2023 and has seen her organic traffic double.
Tom Davidson's event planning business adopted Slack and Trello in November 2023, reducing time spent on meetings and email.
Emily Nguyen, a local florist, saw more repeat customers after adopting CRM software in late September 2023; CRMs named are Salesforce and HubSpot.
Security expert David Clarke has helped SMEs tailor security measures since 2023, producing a substantial decrease in potential breaches.
Restaurant owner Lisa Huang integrated contactless payment in fall 2023; tools named are Apple Pay, Google Wallet and Square.
Jacob Martinez, whose company sells sustainable home goods, reported a 40% increase in inquiries from digital ads since September 2023.
Second quarter 2023 data shows mobile traffic surpasses desktop; bookseller Marissa Cooper's online sales spiked after a mobile website revamp in late 2023.
Chiara Rossi's graphic design firm moved to automation in November 2023 using tools like Zapier or Automate.io.
George Kim's hardware store has used AI-driven analytics since December 2023 to refine inventory management and customer targeting.
